trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Report slow data and provide MSISDN.
steps.text: சாயங்காலம் internet சுத்தமா work ஆகல. நம்பர் MSN-2004.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and inform the user that a line diagnostic will be run.
steps.text: சிரமத்திற்கு மன்னிக்கவும். நான் உங்க line-அ செக் பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிஷம் line-ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Run line diagnostic to check signal strength.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the diagnostic tool using the MSISDN provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules require running a line diagnostic to establish the line condition.

steps.purpose: Inform user of weak signal and ask for pincode to check network status.
steps.text: உங்க line diagnostic-ல signal கொஞ்சம் weak-ஆ இருக்கு. உங்க area pincode சொன்னீங்கன்னா, network status செக் பண்ணலாம்.

steps.expected_behavior: Ask the user to confirm the corrupted pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: The pincode value is critical for checking network status, so the agent must confirm the misheard value.

steps.purpose: Correct the pincode and urge the agent to hurry.
steps.text: இல்ல, 700019. சீக்கிரம் செக் பண்ணுங்க. எனக்கு time இல்ல.
steps.clean_text: இல்ல, 700019. சீக்கிரம் செக் பண்ணுங்க. எனக்கு time இல்ல.
steps.model_visible_text: இல்ல, 700019. சீக்கிரம் செக் பண்ணுங்க. எனக்கு time இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided pincode.
Check network status for the given pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the network status tool with the MSISDN and corrected pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: Check for known outages or congestion in the user's area.

steps.purpose: Inform the user of the congestion issue and ETA.
steps.expected_behavior: State the congestion issue and the 48-hour ETA exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: உங்க detail verify ஆயிடுச்சு. உங்க area-ல network congestion issue இருக்கு. இது 48 hours-ல சரியாகிடும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Communicate the tool's ETA and outage status as required by the business rules.

steps.purpose: Question the ETA and ask about speed improvements.
steps.text: 48 hours ஆகுமா? அதுக்கப்பறம் speed நல்லா இருக்குமா?
steps.clean_text: 48 hours ஆகுமா? அதுக்கப்பறம் speed நல்லா இருக்குமா?
steps.model_visible_text: 48 hours ஆகுமா? அதுக்கப்பறம் speed நல்லா இருக்குமா?

steps.purpose: Ground the response in the tool output and refuse to promise further improvements.
steps.expected_behavior: Reiterate the 48-hour window and explicitly decline to guarantee better speed afterward.
steps.text: இந்த congestion issue 48 hours-ல சரியாகிடும்னு update இருக்கு. அதுக்கு மேல speed improve ஆகும்னு என்னால promise பண்ண முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: Adhere to the rule forbidding promises of coverage improvement beyond the stated window.

steps.purpose: Request a ticket and reference number.
steps.text: சரி, ticket raise பண்ணி எனக்கு reference நம்பர் குடுங்க.
steps.clean_text: சரி, ticket raise பண்ணி எனக்கு reference நம்பர் குடுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: சரி, ticket raise பண்ணி எனக்கு reference நம்பர் குடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Refuse to raise a duplicate ticket for a known issue.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain that a ticket cannot be raised because it is a known issue, and restate the ETA.
steps.text: ஏற்கனவே known issue இருக்கறதால, புதுசா ticket raise பண்ண முடியாது சார். ETA 48 hours தான்.
steps.planner_rationale: Enforce the business rule that no duplicate ticket is raised for a known outage.

steps.purpose: Accept the resolution and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Subscriber told a known outage covers them and given its ETA.
